name: NEXTDC S3 Sydney

address.note: Gore Hill Technology Park (former ABC Gore Hill site)

lat.note: geocoded: address point for 2 Broadcast Way

builder.note: head contractor for Stage 1 and Stage 2

mw_it.note: ultimate capacity; fit-out phased (about 60 MW built at 1H26 per master.csv notes)

cost_aud_m.note: planning capital investment value $238,293,113 for DA-2019/79 (planning panel page; also in the SNPP report for the modification, source 3). Previous value 1000 was the operator/media '$1b' total-development figure at opening (source 4), which includes fit-out

authority.note: Willoughby Council DA determined by the regional panel (panel ref PPS-2019SNH027). Modification DA-2019/79/A (PPSSNH-102) also determined by SNPP on 10 Dec 2020

pathway.value: Regionally significant DA (council DA determined by planning panel)

reference.note: Willoughby DA; panel ref PPS-2019SNH027. Applicant/owner NEXTDC Limited. Modification DA-2019/79/A (PPSSNH-102, lodged 12 Jun 2020, approved 10 Dec 2020)

lodged.note: lodgement date on the planning panel page (referred to panel 05/04/2019). PlanningAlerts shows 03 Apr 2019 (source 5)

determined.note: approved at SNPP public meeting 17 December 2019 (Determination and Statement of Reasons); the modification report (source 3) also says 'approved by SNPP on 17 December 2019'

jobs_construction.note: no construction jobs figure in the DA assessment report

jobs_operational.note: Council assessment report (2019SNH027): 'The data centre is proposed to operate 24 hours x 7 days per week and will employ approximately 45 staff.'

construction_start.note: DCD 'Construction begins on NextDC's S3' as summarised by search (Multiplex phase 1, 24 March 2021). Not verified against the full article; Multiplex appointment may have been earlier

construction_end.note: Stage 2 (final stage, started Jan 2022) completed 'two months ahead of schedule', reported 14 Jun 2023 (source 12; Multiplex release, source 2). Stage 1 completed Aug 2022 (Build Australia 17 Aug 2022, source 11) and S3 officially opened 21 Sep 2022 (iTnews, source 4). Previous value was 2022 (Stage 1)

open_questions: construction start March 2021 not verified against the primary source (DCD and Multiplex pages return 403)
construction jobs figure not found in the DA documents
